audit.whatIsWrong: Full-layer chart carried 'Skill' on six rows while the content layer and packet chart both read Zed/Skill/Skill/Zed/Zed/Zed/Orianna.
audit.why: Zed edges level 1 before her ball combo ramps, 2-3 even to Command: Attack plus the Command: Protect shield, 4 through first item Zed against an immobile mage, and 2+ items Orianna in grouped fights.
audit.corrected: Four mismatched sides proposed as one group, with phases[6].why rewritten so the sentence states Orianna winning that row.

audit.why: Zed spikes at 4-6 and first item; Orianna's are rank-5 Command: Attack at a 3s cooldown and Command: Shockwave dropping to 80s at rank 3.

audit.whatIsWrong: packet.defects: the full layer never named a single Orianna ability. Command: Protect's shield and the armour/MR it grants, and Command: Dissonance's slow field, were both absent.
audit.why: Those two are what actually punish a dash-in when the ball is parked on her body; Command: Shockwave was the only thing the page tracked.
audit.corrected: Command: Attack, Command: Dissonance and Command: Protect named with their real cooldowns in breakdown.cooldowns, breakdown.trading, dosFull[1].d and dontsFull[2].d.

audit.why: It is the field that carries real numbers.
audit.corrected: Shockwave 110s/80s, Command: Attack 3s at rank 5, Command: Protect 9s.

audit.whatIsWrong: Ten fields called Orianna 'he/his/him'; dosFull[1].d was tradeGood verbatim and dontsFull[2].d was tradeBad verbatim.
audit.why: Orianna is female and the bodies did not match their titles.
